data.description:
## testing_mode: UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions (structural test side):
- DD1: structural test asserting Inputs row is present in Tell-Me-More probe table
- DD2: structural test asserting Inputs bullet with permitted values and no TBD escape is in Understanding Summary template

## What to Do
Extend `tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh` with a new section `test_inputs_dimension` containing 4 structural assertions about `plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md`. Also add a RED marker to `.test-index`.

## Files to Modify
- `tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh` — add new section before `echo "=== Results ==="`
- `.test-index` — add RED marker for SKILL.md → this test file

## New Test Section
Add this section immediately before the Results section (the `echo "=== Results ===" block at the end of the file):

```bash
echo ""
echo "=== test_inputs_dimension ==="
SECTION="test_inputs_dimension"

# Assertion 1: Inputs row in Tell-Me-More probe table (DD1)
if grep -q '| Inputs |' "$SKILL_MD" 2>/dev/null; then
  pass "SKILL.md Phase 1 Tell-Me-More table contains Inputs row"
else
  fail "SKILL.md Phase 1 Tell-Me-More table missing Inputs row"
fi

# Assertion 2: **Inputs** bullet in Understanding Summary template (DD2)
if grep -qE '\*\*Inputs\*\*' "$SKILL_MD" 2>/dev/null; then
  pass "SKILL.md Understanding Summary template contains **Inputs** bullet"
else
  fail "SKILL.md Understanding Summary template missing **Inputs** bullet"
fi

# Assertion 3: "no external inputs" permitted value documented (DD2)
if grep -q '"no external inputs"' "$SKILL_MD" 2>/dev/null; then
  pass "SKILL.md documents \"no external inputs\" as permitted Inputs value"
else
  fail "SKILL.md missing permitted value \"no external inputs\" for Inputs bullet"
fi

# Assertion 4: No TBD escape in Inputs bullet (DD2 - no TBD escape constraint)
# shellcheck disable=SC2016  # no expansion intended in single quotes
if ! grep -qE '\*\*Inputs\*\*.*TBD' "$SKILL_MD" 2>/dev/null; then
  pass "SKILL.md Inputs bullet has no TBD escape value"
else
  fail "SKILL.md Inputs bullet contains TBD escape (must not be permitted)"
fi
```

## .test-index Entry
Add the following line to `.test-index` after the existing `plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md:...` line, appending to the comma-separated list:

Actually, add it as a standalone RED marker by finding the SKILL.md entry and appending `,tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh [test_inputs_dimension]` to the end of the SKILL.md line if not already present.

Wait — check if `tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh` is already in the SKILL.md line. If it is (without a bracket qualifier), add a new entry:
```
plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md:tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh [test_inputs_dimension]
```
as a SEPARATE LINE after the existing SKILL.md entry.

Format: source:test [section_name] — space before bracket.

## RED State Expectation
After committing Task 1, assertions 1-3 will FAIL (RED) because SKILL.md has no Inputs row or bullet yet. Assertion 4 will PASS. This is intentional TDD UPDATE pattern. The RED marker in .test-index provides tolerance so the pre-commit test gate allows the commit in this intentional RED state.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Syntax check passes
  Verify: bash -n tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh
- [ ] Section exists in test file
  Verify: grep -q "test_inputs_dimension" tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh
- [ ] RED marker in .test-index for SKILL.md → progressive-validation.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'brainstorm/SKILL.md.*\[test_inputs_dimension\]' .test-index
- [ ] Assertions 1-3 FAIL RED (canonical RED confirmation, section-specific)
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "FAIL: test_inputs_dimension"
- [ ] Assertion 4 PASSES in current state (no TBD escape, no bullet yet)
  Verify: count=$(bash tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh 2>&1 | grep "FAIL: test_inputs_dimension" | wc -l); [ "$count" -lt 4 ]

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
